spec_match.rationale: Built on the spec's [SameObject] device.gatt attribute plus the new EventTarget inheritance — the pairing that makes attach-once listeners survive reconnects — with the identity check (device.gatt === firstRef) run on every cycle.

interactive.rationale: Pair, deliberate drop, and stop controls; a real exponential-backoff reconnect loop against the same server object; identity, cycle, and connected readouts plus a live log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises identity proof, the backoff pattern, and the stale-listener bug it prevents; the page and its code section deliver all three.

edge_cases.rationale: Backoff exhaustion ends in an honest offline state; user can stop the loop; chooser dismissal handled as normal; pre-157 builds get the identity demo with the listener-persistence limitation stated.

references.rationale: chromestatus link, spec PR ([SameObject]), and the sibling size-change-event demo cross-linked.

conformance.rationale: Consistent with the suite; the live-dispatch manual assertion covers the hardware-only part.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Fallback prerequisites branch verified on both classes in headless Chromium 141 (API absent, pair disabled, honest flag guidance; zero console errors; screenshots read). The reconnect loop and identity proof need hardware plus Web Bluetooth, unavailable here — code-reviewed only.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts for support probe, connect, same-object identity per cycle, listener survival per event, and pair termination.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; log/event/error colours at AA on stone.

accessibility.rationale: aria-live support panel and labelled log, dl readouts, three buttons with truthful disabled management.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow on either class via CDP; readout grid wraps at 360.

openQuestions.title: Hardware pass: prove listener persistence across a real power-cycle
openQuestions.detail: On a Chrome 157 build with a BLE device: connect, power-cycle the device, let the backoff reconnect, then trigger an MTU renegotiation and confirm the log line 'through the ONCE-attached listener' appears with cycles ≥ 1. This is the demonstrable payoff of [SameObject] + EventTarget and currently rests on code review.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce long-running async loop progress via a labelled polite live region; keep stop controls reachable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Log is aria-live=polite; Stop button enables whenever the loop runs and the loop honours it between attempts.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit readout grids; bounded scrolling log.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied as on the sibling live-events page.

summary: The advanced-composition concept: [SameObject] identity + EventTarget inheritance = attach-once resilience, with a real backoff loop. Environment verifies the honest fallbacks; the hardware proof is the recorded open question.
